preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2026 Canadian car). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.
